verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim layout-aware parsing that turns complex tables into clean markdown and can pull every table into DataFrames with page provenance, and one hands-on user praised its complex-layout results. However, nothing specifically addresses merged cells, nested headers or tables spanning pages. One community user reported table numbers were not returned in tabular form, which weakens confidence. Missing for 10: documented handling of merged cells and nested/multi-level headers, multi-page table stitching, HTML table output, independent corroboration of table-structure fidelity.
